title: Silhouettes at Sunset
description: A surreal scene at sunset features large silhouetted African women with elaborate colorful headwraps and patterns, one wearing a pilot uniform. In the foreground, a table holds a cheeseburger meal with fries, a glass of red wine, and their reflections shimmer in the water below. A commercial airplane flies across a dramatic red and orange sky toward a gothic cathedral cityscape.
prompt: Surreal sunset scene with large black silhouettes of African women in profile, one wearing a pilot uniform and green patterned headwrap, another with intricate yellow and purple circular patterns. A red devil emoji appears near fast food on a table with a cheeseburger, fries, and glass of red wine. Commercial airplane flying over a gothic cathedral city skyline against a fiery red and orange sky, reflections in foreground water.
